name: conductor-merge-gates
description: NOUS.CONDUCTOR.MERGE_GATES.1 — live staging-HEAD merge invariant. Fetches the origin/staging tip from the GitHub REST API immediately before every PATCH merge request; fetch failure = hard abort; 409 = merge_conflict logged, clause not advanced. NOUS.CONDUCTOR.MERGE_GATES.2 — post-merge two-phase build gate (tsc --noEmit then production bundle build) runs against the merged staging checkout; either phase non-zero = clause not advanced to shipped.
